text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
It's so fluffy and cute—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It really does feel just like it.
It's the exact same sensation I felt in my hands as a child.
choice_data_list: Please take this, if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
! ...Thank you very much.
However—please, keep this in the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
This child connects me to my mother,
but now, it connects me to you as well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I want it to stay by your side—you, who bridged the memories between me and my mother.
choice_data_list: If that's the case, then of course!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here,
shall we go show this to Craft-san?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I'm sure they'll make some cute outfits for you.
